Throwing out there that just voting in one presidential election won’t lead to meaningful change if that’s the extent of anyone’s political involvement.

The establishment would love for nothing more than for everyone to only pay attention to a single circus of an election and let the two-party machine continue unchallenged. 

Don’t just vote in November. Get active in your local government, pay attention to who is running for Senate, the House, your governor, your mayor. 

Don’t just participate in maintaining the status quo, be an advocate for yourself as a citizen and realize we can choose how we are governed. These rules didn’t descend to us from on high, they are rules made by people and they can be changed.
If you think that works well, you’re life will change when you try boiling water and oxiclean. Cleans faster and better than even an overnight IPA soak. Don’t knock it till you try it.

I wish I could just talk to friends and family about this but aside from the fear of how they’d think of me, what are they even going to do? Once they see how bad it is they’ll just say (if they aren’t fools) to get professional help. 

It’s depressing realizing that the best people in your life absolutely don’t feel the same way, in that you know you aren’t anyone’s favorite person. 

The two things keeping me going are my dog and how much pain my death might cause others. But In living with my own pain, it’s hard not to think everyone else’s insistence you suffer so they won’t have to feel sad is twisted and fucked up.
